interface.defaultPrompt: Use the Superpowers Workflow to approach this coding task systematically: clarify the goal, choose a workflow, test first, and verify before claiming completion.
interface.longDescription: A skills-only adaptation of Superpowers' engineering methodology. Helps coding agents clarify requirements, plan implementation, apply test-driven development, debug from evidence, review code, and verify before reporting completion. It does not include upstream session hooks or automatic skill syncing.

name: superpowers-workflow
description: A structured software-development workflow inspired by obra/superpowers: clarify intent, plan carefully, test first, debug systematically, review changes, and verify results.
